description:
Import a CSV file into a session.

The bank format (Chase, US Bank, Schwab, SoFi, PayPal, Coinbase, a
checkbook register, or generic) is detected from the header row.
Rows already in the session are skipped. A checkbook register also
writes its payee and category onto matching bank transactions
(same amount, within one day).

account_name.description: Account name to file these transactions under; empty means the filename without its extension.

content.description: The whole CSV file as text, header row first; comma- or tab-delimited.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

filename.description: The file's name (e.g. "chase-4821-2025.csv"); its stem names the account unless account_name is given, and a 20xx year in it dates checkbook rows that lack a year.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

session_id.description: TaxSort session id (the UUID string create_session returns; list_sessions lists yours).

name: taxsort_import_csv
title: Import a CSV file
